title: Payments release breaks part of checkout
alert: HighErrorRate on payments, orders and api-gateway
query: Checkout started failing with 502s right after the payments release went out. Error rate alerts on all three services.
root_cause: A regression in the new payments release makes some charge requests raise an unhandled error.

remediation.detail: Roll payments back to the previous version (v1.0.0).

evidence: Deploy log shows payments changed from v1.0.0 to v1.1.0 shortly before the first error
Payments logs show unhandled exception entries with a KeyError
Orders logs show payment failed while payments is the only service with stack traces
query_paraphrase: Right after the new payments version went live, a lot of customers started getting errors at checkout, and the dashboards for the gateway, orders and payments all lit up.
